description:
Publish an offer

Lists a draft whose health test and identity checks passed: it goes live within about a minute and is checked continuously from then on. Its key needs the seller's statement on record: pass `statement` (the version from the `list_supply_presets` tool) to accept it. A draft not ready yet, or a key without the statement, is a 409. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique string so that repeating this call never creates twice.

statement.description: The statementVersion of GET /sell/presets: accepts the seller's statement for the offer's key, if it is not on record yet.

name: publish_offer
title: Publish an offer
